messages.content: “Thanks for calling HappyRobot Logistics. I’m Daniel, your carrier sales assistant. I can help you find available loads. Can I get your MC number?”
Thanks. I have your MC number as 135797; I’ll check its operating authority now.
That is correct. I am calling about a load from Anchorage, Alaska. My equipment is a Dry Van. Do you have anything available from there?
Your authority is confirmed. I’ll send a verification code to your screen now.
I have not received a verification code yet. Since we are looking for a load, can you check on load ID LD00719 from Anchorage to Sarasota, Florida? I have a Dry Van ready.
I can’t check the load until verification is completed. The code should appear on your screen; please read the six digits to me.

Ah, I see. I don't have a screen code yet because we haven't booked or completed a delivery. I was hoping to inquire about load ID LD00719 from Anchorage to Sarasota first to see if it's available for my Dry Van. Can you look that one up?
A screen verification code is required before I can look up loads. Please start a new demo call when you’re ready to complete verification.
